# ABOUTME: Negative fixture -- carries exactly one WARN finding (STAB-004) and nothing else.
# ABOUTME: It is what makes `--severity warn --exit-code` provably able to go red.
#
# The defect this pins: a `gaudi check --severity warn --exit-code` that counts
# error findings only gives a caller who asked for a warn-level gate one that
# cannot fail. This file has no error-severity finding, so such a gate would
# stay green with a finding on the report.

from functools import cache


@cache
def double(value: int) -> int:
    """Double a number."""
    return value * 2
